This note was written by knowlet at a release that pre-dated frontmatter
schema versioning. It has no `schema_version` and no `status` field.

The contract: current-code must read this file (defaulting schema_version
to 1, status to "active"), preserve every other field, and on the next
write upgrade it to v2.
